major_findings.title: Pause failure cannot reach adapter recovery
major_findings.detail: Notify logs Streamer.Send errors and always returns nil, so the adapter cannot apply the proposed commit-on-pause-failure rule.
major_findings.required_decision: Permit error propagation through the existing Notify owner or choose another internal control delivery mechanism.

major_findings.title: Deadline delivery and shutdown are not bounded
major_findings.detail: A timer callback can block on the control queue after shutdown or when the queue is full, and stopping the timer does not retire a callback already running.
major_findings.required_decision: Define cancellable deadline delivery and recovery that never leaves output paused.

major_findings.title: Same-context late STT cannot be attributed
major_findings.detail: After candidate A continues, candidate B may start in the same context. A delayed transcript from A is indistinguishable from B without STT utterance provenance.
major_findings.required_decision: Either add minimal internal utterance attribution or prohibit transcript-based early commitment in the first implementation.

major_findings.title: Candidate-free word and text interruption is unspecified
major_findings.detail: Existing word-triggered and direct text paths can commit interruption without a VAD-created candidate, but the proposed TurnChange validation requires one pending candidate.
major_findings.required_decision: Define a separate direct-text commit path or create a candidate for those triggers.

major_findings.title: Reset-before-replay ordering is not guaranteed
major_findings.detail: EOS and TTS interruption handlers are asynchronous, so enqueue order cannot guarantee old reset completion before held STT replay.
major_findings.required_decision: Add a completion barrier or keep replay out of the first implementation.

major_findings.title: Flush lacks an output admission barrier
major_findings.detail: Old audio can pass its context check and enqueue after flush, and the later public interruption notification can clear new audio.
major_findings.required_decision: Define one lock or ordered output path covering context admission, internal flush, and public notification.

minor_findings.title: Verification and active-output coverage are incomplete
minor_findings.detail: The plan needs exact lifecycle, model, type, active-output, blocked-control, punctuation, and streamer coverage.

positive_assessment: One adapter candidate and a fixed window are appropriately small once freshness and ordering are specified
All-consumer rollout as one release unit is appropriate
next_action: Obtain maintainer decisions for the six major findings before another RFC revision or implementation.
